app.title: Diabetes report interpreter
app.disclaimer: For screening and education. A clinician confirms the diagnosis.
app.ghana: Made for everyday life in Ghana
app.footer: Your values. Your understanding. Your next step.
theme.label: Colour theme
connection.error: The service is unavailable. Try connecting again.
connection.offline: You are offline. Reconnect to use account services.
report.heading: Understand your lab report.
report.intro: Check your blood sugar results against the original report, then get a clear explanation of what they mean.
report.description: You will be able to take a photo or choose a report from your phone. Every extracted value must be reviewed before it is explained.
report.unavailable: Report upload is not available yet.
report.limits: One file, up to 5 pages and 20 MiB
report.preview_body: Your reviewed lab values will appear here. Nothing has been uploaded.
report.privacy_body: Guest reports are not saved to history. A verified account lets you choose which reviewed results to keep.
report.steps_heading: A careful review, one step at a time
report.step_one_body: Choose a clear photo or a laboratory PDF.
report.step_two_body: Compare the extracted tests, values and units with the source.
report.step_three_body: Read the explanation and prepare for a clinician conversation.
history.heading: Keep your results together.
history.intro: Saved reports will help you follow the same test over time.
history.empty_body: Only results you choose to save will appear here.
history.guest_heading: Your history starts with an account
history.guest_body: Sign in to a verified account to keep reviewed results. Guest sessions do not create a history.
account.heading: A home for your reviewed results.
account.intro: Create an account to save reports when report upload becomes available.
account.password_hint: Use 15 to 128 characters. A phrase is easier to remember.
account.verification_body: Verify your email before saving any reports. Check your inbox for a verification link.
account.ready_body: Your account is ready. Reviewed reports will only be saved when you choose to keep them.
account.scope: One consenting adult per account. A caregiver can assist with permission.
account.privacy: No report values are included in account emails.
account.request_failed: The request could not be completed. Please try again.
account.missing_link: This link is incomplete. Request a new email and try again.
auth.check_email: If this address can be used, an email with the next step will arrive shortly.
auth.reset_sent: If the account exists, a password reset link will arrive shortly.
auth.email_verified: Your email has been verified. You can sign in now.
auth.password_updated: Your password has been updated. Sign in with your new password.
auth.invalid_credentials: The email or password is incorrect.
auth.invalid_token: This link is invalid, expired or has already been used. Request another email.
auth.password_length: Use a password between 15 and 128 characters.
auth.password_common: This password is too common. Choose a longer, less predictable phrase.
auth.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Please wait before trying again.
auth.verification_required: Verify your email before saving reports.
auth.csrf_invalid: Your form session has expired. Try submitting again.
auth.origin_invalid: This request could not be verified. Return to the app and try again.

request.invalid: Check your email, password and required fields, then try again.
request.not_found: This page or resource is unavailable.
